title: X Post from @TwinPortsPrep: "Nationwide Blackout Tonight"

fields.avatarBrief: bearded man in a blaze-orange knit hat and camo jacket, selfie in front of a snowy pickup truck, Lake Superior in the background
fields.text: G5 EXTREME just confirmed. NATIONWIDE BLACKOUT TONIGHT, grid operators already losing transformers in Minnesota. Gas up NOW, cell towers go next. #G5 #Blackout
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo at dusk of a long line of cars and pickups queued at a gas station in a snowy northern Minnesota town, green and pink aurora faintly visible in the twilight sky above the canopy lights
fields.attachedImageAlt: Cars lined up at a gas station under a faint aurora at dusk

instructorNote: Misinformation inject (the handle is shortened to @TwinPortsPrep to fit the platform). Give it to COM at 17:53 along with the @NorthStarTruthNow "cyberattack" post and the HSEM "G4, ends 22:00" forward. Watch whether COM logs both rumors and checks with CRSS that no load is lost. Then look for a correction that quotes the SWPC 17:47 G5 alert, gives no end time earlier than SWPC's, states NLTO's actions, sends storm questions to SWPC, says nothing about security, and gets HSEM to update its wording.

citations.quote: | Condition | Public statement | |---|---| | Condition 1 (watch) | No public message unless asked. A media statement is ready: "NLTO is monitoring a space weather forecast and has procedures in place.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. Candid phone snapshot at dusk taken from the driver's seat area outside a small-town gas station in snowy northern Minnesota in March: a long line of cars, SUVs and pickup trucks queued bumper to bumper toward the pumps, headlights and red taillights glowing, exhaust vapour rising in the cold air. A plain bright canopy lights the pumps and a few bundled-up drivers stand by their open doors. Plowed snowbanks along the road, bare birch and dark spruce behind the lot. Above the canopy, a deep blue twilight sky shows faint green and pink aurora curtains. Slight tilt, mild grain, mixed sodium and LED lighting, urgent, anxious mood. Setting: at a rural high-voltage substation at night: large transformers, bundled conductors on steel towers, frost on the gravel, a faint green aurora low on the horizon
